macros.name: addgrouptolop
macros.doc: You add a group to the list of poems by using \addgrouptolop, which functions just like \addtolop does.

macros.name: centerpoemoff
macros.doc: \centerpoemon sets the centering mechanism on, and (obviously) \centerpoemoff turns it off.

macros.name: centerpoemon
macros.doc: \centerpoemon sets the centering mechanism on, and (obviously) \centerpoemoff turns it off.

macros.name: listofpoems
macros.doc: Just add \listofpoems wherever you want your list of poems to appear.

macros.name: poemauthorposthook
macros.doc: \poemauthorprehook and \poemauthorposthook, inserted before and after the author.

macros.name: poemauthorprehook
macros.doc: \poemauthorprehook and \poemauthorposthook, inserted before and after the author.

macros.name: poemblanktitle
macros.doc: \poemblanktitle is the word that poetry will use when it’s asked to typeset a title but it doesn’t have one; by default, this is set as Untitled.

macros.name: poembotskip
macros.doc: \poemtopskip is inserted above the poem, and \poembotskip is inserted below it.

macros.name: poemfirstline
macros.doc: use \poemfirstline, which takes a single argument, which is the entry you want to appear in the index. This command will not typeset its argument in the document, only send it to the index.

macros.name: poemgroupheading
macros.doc: \poemgroupheading prints a heading for the poem group.

macros.name: poemgroupotherstyle
macros.doc: The “other” argument can be styled with \poemgroupotherstyle, which by default contains simply \LARGE.

macros.name: poemgrouptitlestyle
macros.doc: The title can be styled by redefining \poemgrouptitlestyle, which by default simply contains \Huge.

macros.name: poemhinwd
macros.doc: The indentation given by \hin is controlled by the LaTeX length \poemhinwd, which can be set however the user wishes.

macros.name: poemindent
macros.doc: \poemindent is the length that governs how far the poem will be indented from the left margin.

macros.name: poemlinenumrightfalse
macros.doc: To place line numbers on the right, use \poemlinenumrighttrue; to put them back on the left, use the corresponding command \poemlinenumrightfalse.

macros.name: poemlinenumrighttrue
macros.doc: To place line numbers on the right, use \poemlinenumrighttrue; to put them back on the left, use the corresponding command \poemlinenumrightfalse.

macros.name: poemnew
macros.doc: Issue \poemnew prior to starting your poem environment; it will increment your counters without putting anything in your text.

macros.name: poemtitleprehook
macros.doc: \poemtitleprehook is inserted by poetry prior to the title text, and \poemtitleposthook is inserted afterward.

macros.name: poemtopskip
macros.doc: \poemtopskip is inserted above the poem, and \poembotskip is inserted below it.

macros.name: poemverseskip
macros.doc: \poemverseskip, which controls the distance between verses (stanzas) of the poem.

macros.name: poemvsindentlines
macros.doc: \poemvsindentlines allows you to arrange the indentation on each verse with very fine detail, assuming that all your verses are indented the same way.

macros.name: printiofl
macros.doc: Use \printiofl at whatever point in your document you want the index to actually appear.

macros.name: thepoemlicense
macros.doc: The variable is \thepoemlicense, and defaults to the string Public Domain.

macros.name: thepoemtitle
macros.doc: \thepoemtitle holds the currently defined poem title, if any.

macros.name: titleauthorpoem
macros.doc: \titleauthorpoem resets both \thepoemtitle and \thepoemauthor to the values you submit. poetry also gives you hooks to control the appearance of these macros.

macros.name: titlepoem
macros.doc: \titlepoem will reset the variable \thepoemtitle to whatever argument you give it.

envs.name: poem
envs.doc: \begin{poem} and \end{poem} will get your poem off and running, no questions asked.
